description: What changed on the map since a date. Input: since (YYYY-MM-DD; an ISO-8601 timestamp is cut to its date), optional step, record_id, limit. Returns dated rows with record, kind, field, old and new value, claim, evidence URL and the data commit.

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or an ISO-8601 timestamp (its offset is applied, then the UTC date is used)

name: changes
